description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: How have selected Agent Weather snapshot metrics changed since a cursor? Raw first/last values per metric; optional rank=abs_delta|rel_delta orders them by measured change (published rule). Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

limit.description: Optional, ranked mode only. Items to return (default 3).

metrics.description: Comma list of snapshot metrics, max 5

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

rank.description: Optional. Order the requested snapshot metrics by measured change (published rule in the response's ranking.rule). Not a rating or advice.

since.description: ISO 8601 or unix ms. Required unless rank is set; in ranked mode defaults to a rolling 7 days (max 7 days)

name: readings_changes
title: Changes since last check (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
